purpose: Визуальные ориентиры; не готовые игровые фоны. Тексты и номера на изображениях — примеры.

mockups.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one polished portrait mobile game screen concept for a personal Russian Christmas advent letter hunt. This is a visual preview, not an implemented website.
Primary request: Show the illustrated winter-house direction: a cozy armchair beside a snowy window, a bookshelf, and subtly hidden sealed letters. Make it feel like stepping inside an intimate hand-painted storybook.
Format: single tall portrait image, approximately 9:19 phone screen proportions, straight-on full-bleed screen artwork, no physical phone bezel, no presentation board, no multiple screens.
Scene: a warmly lit reading nook in a winter home. A large plush muted burgundy armchair with a cream knitted throw and cushion is central. Beside it a small wooden side table with a steaming ceramic cup and a warmly glowing shaded reading lamp. A tall snowy window behind the chair reveals indigo evening, snowflakes and snow-covered firs. On the left a wooden bookshelf with a modest number of substantial books and a small drawer. Restrained evergreen garland and tiny warm lights frame the window. Wooden floor and patterned rug. Compose everything at a large readable scale for a real phone, with calm uncluttered silhouettes and interesting nooks for a hidden-object game.
Style: sophisticated 2D hand-painted editorial storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolor texture on paper, delicate pencil edges, tactile fabrics, gently imperfect shapes, atmospheric but clear, inviting and personal. Not childish, not photorealistic, not 3D, not isometric, not flat vector.
Palette: creamy plaster, honey amber light, warm walnut, muted burgundy, forest green, deep blue snowy outdoors. Strong cozy warm/cool contrast.
Letter hiding: exactly three small sealed ivory envelopes present in this scene. One envelope is partly tucked between two books, one has just its triangular corner peeking from behind the armchair cushion, one lies discreetly beneath the cup saucer with only part visible. They are believable objects in the scene, not glowing collectibles and not labeled. Do not expose hidden content, mood labels, gift numbers or actual gifts. Do not mark their locations with arrows.
Interface: minimal elegant Russian game UI integrated into the illustration, with clearly readable typography. Top safe area: small scene title "Тихий уголок"; below it a small cream paper pill with an envelope icon and exact text "Найдено 0 из 15". No large header block. At bottom, discreet circular left and right navigation chevrons, and a small paper-style button labeled "Подсказка" with a subtle star icon. Above bottom navigation one short line "Загляни в уютные уголки". The art occupies almost the entire screen. Interface touch targets look comfortable. No extra copy, no phone status bar, no watermark, no logos.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: single portrait mobile game screen concept, approximately 9:19 aspect ratio, full bleed illustration without device bezel.
Input image: the supplied reading-nook image is a STYLE AND WORLD REFERENCE. Create a NEW SCENE in the SAME HOME, not a modified chair scene. Closely match its hand-painted gouache and watercolor, paper grain, delicate pencil edges, vintage cozy atmosphere, creamy paper UI, muted burgundy and forest green, walnut wood, amber lamplight and indigo snow outdoors.
Primary request: Show the second stage of this personal Russian Christmas letter-hunt game, after ALL 15 letters have been found: a welcoming wooden writing desk with a glowing lamp and a collection of exactly FIFTEEN sealed envelopes. The desk is the main subject and occupies most of the image.
Composition: slightly elevated three-quarter overhead view toward a broad walnut desktop, allowing envelopes to be seen clearly. At upper right the SAME distinctive brass lamp with scalloped cream fabric shade and embroidered leaf motifs as the reference; warm light pools across the envelopes. Behind the desk a small glimpse of the same snowy blue window, evergreen garland and snow-covered firs. Small restrained details at desk edge: steaming tree-pattern ceramic cup, a fountain pen and a short evergreen sprig. No chair as focal point, no bookshelf dominating the screen. The collection of letters must be the visual focus.
Envelope layout: exactly FIFTEEN physical envelopes total, all closed, all individually distinguishable, no envelopes inside envelopes, no decorative extra envelopes elsewhere. Fourteen modest-sized envelopes rest in four loosely staggered rows (4 + 4 + 3 + 3) in the middle of the desk, with slight overlaps, natural rotations, enough exposed area to see each item. One selected fifteenth envelope rests larger in the foreground in the lower central part of the desk. This is still a physical envelope in the scene, not a separate modal or floating UI card. Maintain generous space between the letter collection and the top heading.
Paper: varied ivory, cream and pale warm blush, subtle paper fibers, burgundy wax seals, a few thin burgundy ribbons or tiny botanical pen decorations. Cohesive intimate stationery, not corporate mail. Smaller envelopes can show restrained handwritten mood headings but their tiny text must not dominate. Two readable small-envelope headings: "Когда хочется приключения" and "Когда хочется вдохновения". Selected large foreground envelope has the clearly readable handwritten Russian inscription "Когда хочется уюта" with a small sprig drawing. Do not show gift numbers, dates, letter contents or actual gifts.
Interface: match the reference's elegant cream-paper visual language and dark warm brown ink. At the very top, exact large heading "Все письма дома". Beneath, smaller exact text "Выбирай по настроению". A small subtle completed collection indicator reads "15 из 15". At the bottom, below the selected foreground envelope, a comfortable cream paper button with exact text "Открыть письмо". Discreet circular left/right chevrons beside the selected envelope suggest cycling the selection. Keep all text inside comfortable phone safe areas. The selected letter is still sealed: the button has not been pressed. The desk and lamplight provide the atmosphere, controls remain minimal.
Style: sophisticated 2D illustrated storybook, richly textured hand-painted interiors, cinematic warm/cool contrast, emotionally personal and peaceful, detailed but with clear mobile-scale composition. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not vector. No device mockup, no multiple screens, no arrows pointing at items, no watermark or logos.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one full-bleed portrait mobile game screen concept, approximately 9:19 phone proportions, no physical device frame.
Input image: supplied image is the STYLE AND CONTINUITY REFERENCE for the same cozy winter writing desk. Create its NEXT SCREEN: a single opened personal letter, close up. Match the hand-painted gouache/watercolor texture, warm walnut wood, ivory paper, burgundy seals, embroidered lampshade, amber lighting and blue snowy window. Not a collage, not multiple screens.
Primary request: Show what the player sees after opening the envelope titled "Когда хочется уюта". An intimate readable personal letter to Dasha, with a clearly separated physical gift number and an explicit button to mark unwrapping.
Composition: the paper letter fills roughly 75% of the width and most of the phone's height, centered, close enough for comfortable mobile reading. Generous paper margins and generous line spacing. Its surface is pale cream with subtle paper grain, low visual noise behind the writing. Natural slightly irregular paper edges, a single gentle fold, tiny hand-painted evergreen and burgundy berry decorations confined to corners. The opened matching envelope peeks out from behind the letter at the lower left; broken wax seal visible. Same walnut desktop around the edges, a partial glowing brass lamp and embroidered cream shade at upper right, a thin glimpse of blue snow outside at the top. A partial tree-pattern ceramic cup and fountain pen near outer edges. Other unopened envelopes only dim cropped suggestions in the far background, not a collection grid; no repeated letter previews. Focus on personal writing and warm pool of light.
Text hierarchy: decorative handwritten heading, then highly legible dark warm-brown Russian body lettering in a restrained readable book serif with a handwritten quality. No excessive cursive in body. Signature can be handwritten. Exact text below, with paragraph breaks, all spelling correct, do not add any other invented prose.
Top subtle navigation outside the letter: "‹ К конвертам"
On the letter, heading:
"Когда хочется уюта"
Salutation:
"Даша,"
Body:
"Пусть сегодня можно будет никуда не спешить.
Устроиться поудобнее, выдохнуть
и оставить все дела на потом.

Мне хочется, чтобы в этих маленьких
сюрпризах ты чувствовала мою любовь.
И чтобы даже самый обычный вечер
становился немного теплее."
Signature:
"Обнимаю тебя.
Твой муж"
Below the signature, integrated on the same sheet but separated by a tiny botanical divider, the gift instruction:
"Твой сюрприз"
Large prominent gift number:
"№ 12"
Smaller line beneath:
"Найди свёрток с этим номером в коробке."
At the very bottom outside the sheet, one comfortable cream paper button with a small gift outline icon and exact label:
"Я распаковала подарок"
This button is visibly UNPRESSED; do not show a completion checkmark or claim the gift is already unwrapped. Number 12 and all message text are illustrative mockup content, no gift contents should be shown. Do not display the wording about mockups inside the product interface.
Style: sophisticated tactile illustrated storybook, delicate pencil edges and rich gouache textures on objects, quietly romantic winter evening. Keep paper contrast and text clarity excellent. No glowing screen within screen, no floating generic app modal, no dark scrim, no big shadows obscuring text, no watermark or logo.
